meta_title: N T Garden Services | Landscape Gardener Newcastle
meta_description: N T Garden Services brings your Newcastle garden to life. Expert landscaping, garden design, and maintenance. Local, reliable, fully insured. Get a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Insured Landscape Gardener — Newcastle & Surrounding Areas
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to bespoke patios, we design and build gardens that suit your home and lifestyle.
services_heading: Complete Garden Design & Landscaping Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: Whether you need a full garden overhaul, routine maintenance, or a one-off tidy, we handle it with care and expertise.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: We create bespoke garden plans tailored to your space, style, and budget. From initial consultation through to final planting, you'll have a garden you love.

services.title: Patio & Decking Installation
services.desc: Professional laying of patios, decking, and hard landscaping. We use quality materials and precise workmanship to create outdoor spaces built to last.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Expert selection and planting of shrubs, trees, and perennials suited to Newcastle's climate. We design borders for year-round colour and interest.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular lawn care, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal upkeep. Monthly or quarterly visits keep your garden healthy and looking its best.

services.title: Fencing & Screening
services.desc: We install durable fencing, trellises, and screening solutions to define boundaries and add privacy to your garden space.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Removal
services.desc: Overgrown? We clear away old plants, debris, and waste responsibly, leaving you with a blank canvas ready for a fresh start.

about_pullquote: I got into this because a beautiful garden changes how you feel about your home every single day.
about_para_1: N T Garden Services has been designing and building gardens across Newcastle and the North East for over 15 years. We started with a passion for creating outdoor spaces that work for real families and businesses. Today, we've completed hundreds of projects — from modest borders to full garden transformations — always with the same care and attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen first, plan thoroughly, and deliver on time. We're not here to upsell; we're here to make your garden something you're genuinely proud of. Every project is insured, every team member trained, and every plant we choose is right for Newcastle's climate.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About N T Garden Services

reviews.text: Transformed our back garden from an absolute mess into somewhere we actually want to spend time. Niall was brilliant — gave us clear advice, didn't rush the job, and the patio looks fantastic. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.text: We had no idea what we wanted at first. Niall drew up a design, we tweaked it together, and the result is even better than we imagined. Very fair pricing and he cleaned up after himself properly. Top bloke.

reviews.text: Been using N T Garden Services for regular maintenance for two years now. The lads are always on time, they know what they're doing, and our garden looks immaculate year-round. Genuinely great value.
reviews.author: Robert H.
